BiblicalUsage: Pallâtsûwth is affright, trembling horror. Fearfulness and trembling come upon the psalmist and horror overwhelms him, and in Ezekiel's day of judgment horror shall cover the people and shame shall be upon all faces.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that horror is fear with no way out: the psalmist feels it and cries to God, and the prophet says a day is coming when it covers a whole people.
